components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a screen: Floodlight Ochre fill, Turf Deep text, raised shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;font:500 16px/1 "DM Sans",sans-serif;color:#0f2d1e;background:#e8a33d;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(0,8,20,0.2),inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.1);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:#f0b55a}@media (hover:hover){.ds-btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,8,20,0.28),inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.1)}}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(0.98);box-shadow:inset 0 4px 8px rgba(0,8,20,0.2),inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.1)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #e8a33d;outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-primary{transition:none}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action: Turf Deep surface, ochre text and a 1px ochre border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;font:500 16px/1 "DM Sans",sans-serif;color:#e8a33d;background:#0f2d1e;border:1px solid #e8a33d;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(0,8,20,0.2),inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.1);cursor:pointer;transition:transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)}@media (hover:hover){.ds-btn-secondary:hover{box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,8,20,0.28),inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.1)}}.ds-btn-secondary:active{transform:scale(0.98);box-shadow:inset 0 4px 8px rgba(0,8,20,0.2),inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.1)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #e8a33d;outline-offset:2px}.ds-btn-secondary:disabled{opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-secondary{transition:none}.ds-btn-secondary:active{transform:none}}

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A text field on turf: pressed inset at rest, ochre focus, red border when invalid.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;font:400 14px/1.5 "DM Sans",sans-serif;color:#f4f1e8}.ds-input{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:12px 16px;background:#0b2116;color:#f4f1e8;font:400 16px/1.5 "DM Sans",sans-serif;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:inset 0 4px 8px rgba(0,8,20,0.2),inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.1);transition:border-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1),box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#c5cdbf;opacity:1}.ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:#e8a33d;box-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,8,20,0.2),inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.15),0 0 4px rgba(255,195,0,0.3)}.ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:#ff6b66}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:0.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The screen is a stadium after dark. Deep turf fills the page, the pitch stripes run faintly beneath it, and warm floodlight drifts across the top of the field. Everything a player needs sits on that dark ground: a card, a bid, a standings row, each one a raised surface lit by ochre. The product's own words, given when the system was reviewed, set the ambition: "one of a kind, very unique, animation-intensive and novel." The look should feel like no other fantasy-sports screen, and the motion is part of that identity rather than an afterthought.

The system is dark-only. The palette was replaced by this stadium-at-night direction; the navy and gold palette in docs/ui/design-system.md is retired. Controls are tactile: raised at rest, pressed when active, lit by an ochre focus. Decoration (floodlight, chalk glow, stripes) lives behind content and never behind text. Density stays moderate, because a season is read over several sessions rather than in one glance.
keyCharacteristics: Dark turf surfaces with ochre as the single warm accent.
Tactile, raised controls that press in on use.
Animation-led identity: a slow-drifting stadium background, a sheen sweep on buttons, and a live pulse on the broadcast frame. Each is off under reduced motion.
Bodoni headings with DM Sans body copy, for a broadcast-grade contrast between display and text.

rules.name: The Behind-The-Play Rule
rules.body: Decorative light and stripes sit behind content and never behind text. The stadium is scenery, and the scoreboard stays in front of it.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Ochre Rule
rules.body: Ochre is a fill, so text on it is Turf Deep, never chalk. Primary buttons follow this rule.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Bodoni speaks only in headings and readouts. DM Sans carries everything a player reads to act on.

rules.name: The Lit-From-Within Rule
rules.body: Depth is a response to state. A control is raised at rest, deepens on hover, and presses in when active. Nothing else gets a shadow.

dos: Take every colour, space, radius, shadow and duration from the tokens.stylex.ts variables; never hard-code them in a component.
Keep text at 4.5:1 or better on its surface, and use Chalk Muted for secondary text on Turf Night.
Make every animation respect prefers-reduced-motion, with a static final state.
Limit animated properties to transform, opacity, color, background-color, border-color and box-shadow.
Gate hover effects to @media (hover: hover) so touch taps do not leave a stuck state.
donts: Don't put chalk text on Floodlight Ochre. Use ink (Turf Deep) on ochre.
Don't place text on the glow, stripe or floodlight layers.
Don't reintroduce the retired navy and gold palette from docs/ui/design-system.md.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, top, left, margin).
Don't remove the reduced-motion switches from the stadium, the sheen or the live pulse.
